async def act(page):
    # Click the 'Issues' link in the project navigation to go to the issues page
    issues_link = page.get_by_role('complementary', name='Project navigation').get_by_role('link', name='Issues')
    await issues_link.click()
    # Wait for the page to load after navigation
    await page.wait_for_load_state('load')
    # Optionally, wait a bit more for any dynamic content
    await page.wait_for_timeout(2000)  # 2 seconds to ensure issues are loaded
    # No further actions needed; the function will return and terminate_with_result will be set
